faqs.question: Does PDF compressor (Portal presets) upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. PDF compressor (Portal presets) executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/pdf/pdf-compress-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate PDF compressor (Portal presets)?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/pdf_compress.json or open /tools/pdf-compress?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
